question: Tell me top10 teams with the most wins across the league
sql:
WITH home_wins AS (
    SELECT home_team_api_id as team_api_id, 1 as wins
    FROM Match
    WHERE home_team_goal > away_team_goal
),
away_wins AS (
    SELECT away_team_api_id as team_api_id, 1 as wins
    FROM Match
    WHERE away_team_goal > home_team_goal
),
team_wins AS (
    SELECT team_api_id, SUM(wins) as total_wins
    FROM (
        SELECT team_api_id, wins FROM home_wins
        UNION ALL
        SELECT team_api_id, wins FROM away_wins
    )
    GROUP BY team_api_id
)
SELECT t.team_long_name, CAST(tw.total_wins AS INTEGER) as total_wins
FROM team_wins tw
JOIN Team t ON tw.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
ORDER BY tw.total_wins DESC
LIMIT 10
